function.name: calculate_projectile_range
function.description: Calculate the range of a projectile launched at an angle with initial velocity, using the kinematic equation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity at which projectile is launched. This is a float type value.

angle.description: The angle at which projectile is launched. This should be in degrees. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds after which the range is to be calculated. This is a float type value.

message.content: 請提供速度 \(v\)、角度 \(\theta\)（單位為度）以及時間 \(t\)（秒）的具體數值，以便我為您計算汽車在這段時間內行駛的距離。

This is essentially projectile motion horizontal distance: range = v * cos(theta) * t. But they mention "calculate_projectile_range" function. That function calculates projectile range given initial_velocity, angle, and optional time (default 0.5). So we can call that function. The user didn't specify time t explicitly? They said "在時間't'內". So we need to ask for t? Or we can assume t=0.5? The function has default time=0.5. But the user might want to input t. We can ask for t. But the instruction says "When calling a function, you must provide all required arguments." The function requires initial_velocity and angle; time is optional.
